observations: Two photos show an industrial printing/packaging machine with teal/white body panels and multiple rollers/frames.
Photo 0 shows the machine from the side with a feed/roller section and a control area on the right.
Photo 1 shows the front/side with a control panel (buttons/indicator lights) and a roller/printing section in the middle.
No clear brand/model nameplate is readable in either photo.
No close-up of the electrical rating plate, serial number, or any working display is shown.

claims.evidence: Photos only show the machine appearance; no running video, no output sample, and no dashboard/operation proof.

risks.risk: Machine may not run correctly under load (rollers, belts, or mechanisms may be worn even if it powers on).
risks.proof: Short video of the machine running continuously (at least 5–10 minutes) showing feed movement and stable operation.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst case: needs service/parts).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect consumables or tooling (dies/rollers/plates) could prevent proper printing/production.
risks.proof: Photos of the exact tooling/rollers/plates included, plus a close-up of any model-specific parts and what is currently installed.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown tooling (worst case: may require additional parts).

risks.risk: Electrical issues (control board, sensors, emergency stop, wiring) may fail intermittently.
risks.proof: Video showing power-up self-check (if any), all indicator lights, and operation with no error codes.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as electrical reliability unproven (worst case: may need electrical repair).

risks.risk: Capacity/specs unknown (paper/film width, max speed, number of stations), affecting value.
risks.proof: Photo of the specification plate/manual page showing width, speed, and model details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest spec/most generic assumption for this machine type.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in these angles (rust, oil leaks, worn bearings, damaged rollers).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of bearings/roller surfaces, any lubrication points, and underside/drive components.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average-wear condition (worst case: visible wear requiring maintenance).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the machine nameplate/spec plate (brand, model, serial number, voltage/Hz).
Running video (5–10 minutes) showing continuous operation and feed/roller movement.
A sample output (printed/packaged product) from the machine, or a photo/video of the finished job.
Close-up photos of rollers/plates/dies and what tooling is included.
Photo/video of any error codes or control panel status during operation.
response.reason: The photos show an industrial printing/packaging machine, but the brand/model and working proof are not readable/visible. Without a running video and nameplate/specs, the worst-case pricing cannot be confidently set.
